messages.subject: procD.lm alternative response variables?
parts:
Hello,

I am working on a manuscript exploring the effects of some island characteristics on the cranial size and shape of insular populations. I remember reading somewhere that procD.lm is not meant to only be used for shape ~ variable models and is actually flexible for other response variables such as size, but I cannot seem to relocate the reference I remember that from.

Is it possible to conduct linear models using procD.lm on models such as "centroid size ~ population"? Or am I mistaken and only Procrustes shape coordinates should be used as the response in procD.lm (i.e., shape ~ population)?

Any advice is greatly appreciated!

Mariah Schlis-Elias
m.cor...@gmail.com

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] procD.lm alternative response variables?
parts:
Mariah,

ProcD.lm may be used on a continuous variable such as shape. Please see the help files for an example.  Also, under that function is lm.rrpp from our RRPP package. It has an extensive help file also.

Dean
